nodes.subject: coffee caffeine level
nodes.object: species, serving and preparation; dark roast generally has very slightly less caffeine than lighter roast rather than more

support_spans.exact_quote: Arabica coffee typically contains half the caffeine of the robusta variety.
In general, dark-roast coffee has very slightly less caffeine than lighter roasts because the roasting process reduces caffeine content of the bean by a small amount.

accepted_phrases: A dark-roast label does not by itself imply more caffeine per cup. The frozen reference says arabica typically contains about half the caffeine of robusta and that dark roast generally has very slightly less caffeine than lighter roast because roasting reduces caffeine slightly; exact cup caffeine still requires dose, species, method, ratio, serving and measurement.

nodes.subject: roasted coffee storage
nodes.object: airtight light-protected whole-bean storage from grounds that stale in days because of increased surface area

support_spans.exact_quote: Roasted whole beans are best stored in airtight containers out of the light.
Due to increased total surface area of coffee grounds, the grounds go stale in days, rather than weeks.

accepted_phrases: The frozen storage reference recommends keeping roasted whole beans airtight and out of light, and states that increased surface area causes grounds to go stale in days rather than weeks. This is a form-and-storage distinction, not a universal expiry date for every sealed bag.

nodes.subject: burr grinder
nodes.object: adjustable coarse-to-fine particle size, with different grind ranges for different brewing systems

support_spans.exact_quote: A burr mill , or burr grinder , is a mill used to grind hard, small food products between two revolving abrasive surfaces separated by a distance usually set by the user.

The grind spectrum ranges from Turkish coffee and espresso on the finer end to a French press , Karlsbad coffee and cold brew extraction on the coarse/extra coarse end, with pour-overs and drip coffee in the medium-fine to medium range.

accepted_phrases: A burr grinder uses adjustable separated abrasive surfaces to produce coarser or finer grounds, and the cited grind spectrum differs across espresso, pour-over, drip and French press methods. A whole-bean route therefore needs an exact grinder matched to the intended method.

nodes.subject: moka pot coffee
nodes.object: vapor pressure around one to two bar rather than the nine-bar standard for espresso

support_spans.exact_quote: The moka pot [ 1 ] [ 2 ] is a stove-top or electric coffee maker that brews coffee by passing hot water driven by vapor pressure and heat-driven gas expansion through ground coffee .

However, a typical moka coffee is extracted at relatively low pressures of 1 to 2 bar (100 to 200 kPa), [ 12 ] while standards for espresso coffee specify a pressure of 9 bar (900 kPa). Therefore, moka coffee is not considered to be an espresso.

accepted_phrases: A moka pot passes hot water through grounds using vapor pressure and heat-driven gas expansion, but typical moka extraction is about one to two bar while espresso standards specify nine bar. Moka coffee therefore must not be presented as machine espresso.
